title: UISD Cherish Center Student Octavio Vallejo Dreams of Becoming a Teacher Aide
excerpt: Octavio Vallejo, an Alexander High School graduate and a United Independent School District Cherish Center student, is gaining work experience at San Isidro Elementary through the district's vocational training program as he works toward his dream of becoming a teacher aide.
content:
Octavio Vallejo, an Alexander High School graduate and a United Independent School District Cherish Center student, loves working with kids and dreams of becoming a teacher aide one day.

Through the Cherish Center's vocational training program, Vallejo is gaining work experience at San Isidro Elementary, where he helps teachers and students and has become a familiar face around campus.

One of the sweetest moments of his journey, according to the district, was reuniting with his former fifth-grade teacher — this time as the one helping her in the classroom.

The district shared Vallejo's story in a video on Monday, Nov. 24, 2026, and said it will keep highlighting Cherish Center students who are thriving at work sites across the community.
